_comment_toolCalling: true lets the model call the six tools (observe, find_blocks, lookup_item, do_task, go_to, stop) before deciding, so it can look at the world instead of imagining it. Requires a provider with native tool calling; the plain intent-JSON exchange works either way, and an invalid or looping tool round falls back to the regex router.
